kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تعاصرت (form VI)
# تَعَاصَرْتُ (taʕāṣartu) /ta.ʕaː.sˤar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
# تَعَاصَرْتَ (taʕāṣarta) /ta.ʕaː.sˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
# تَعَاصَرْتِ (taʕāṣarti) /ta.ʕaː.sˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
# تَعَاصَرَتْ (taʕāṣarat) /ta.ʕaː.sˤa.rat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
